thesis: The page is the dusk window between 7:40 pm and 9:30 pm on a Formosan swarm evening: each section is a moment in that window, and the signature is the clock hand that advances and the lamp glow that dims as you scroll.

signature.name: Dusk Clock + Lamp Glow
signature.summary: A small clock face advances from 7:40 to 9:30 pm via --sw-p; a thin gold lamp-glow rule dims section by section. Reused in hero (clock + glow under kicker), house-type story (lights dim per card), proof (time-stamp pills + glow dividers), and footer (9:30 reset). Hook: data-sw-signature='dusk-clock'.

palette.family: Indigo Dusk + Streetlamp Gold + Wrought Iron

motion.intro: Lights-out helper inputs fade up (opacity 0→1, 500ms); lamp glow warms once. Skippable.
stories: dim: clock hand advances via --sw-p; house card porch lights dim at thresholds
draw: lamp glow rule draws left-to-right under service cards
motion.hover: Lamp glow rule grows from left via scaleX(0→1) on card hover, 200ms ease-out
